content: BPY2, also known as Testis-specific basic protein Y 2 or basic charge, Y-linked 2, is a protein encoded by the BPY2 gene in humans. This gene is located on the Y chromosome, specifically within the non-recombining region of the chromosome. Its expression is restricted to the testis. The protein encoded by the BPY2 gene interacts with ubiquitin protein ligase E3A, suggesting a potential role in the development of male germ cells. It may also be implicated in male infertility. There are three nearly identical copies of the BPY2 gene present on the Y chromosome. Two of these copies are located within a palindromic region of the chromosome, while the copy described in this record is situated outside of the palindromic region.
